text: The Noida Metro Aqua Line extension to Sector 142 was approved by the authority and is expected to be operational by 2027.
A new expressway link road connecting Sector 150 to the Yamuna Expressway is proposed for completion in 2030.
The Noida International Airport at Jewar is under construction and targeted for 2025.
A multi-specialty hospital in Sector 137 has been sanctioned with an expected opening in 2028.
The RRTS rapid rail corridor near Sector 18 is proposed and planned for 2032.
A large shopping mall in Sector 18 is now operational as of 2024.
